title: Define Core Consumer Export Surface
stopConditions: A proposed export removal breaks Editor or Backend without an approved adoption path.
A Core boundary claim relies on Project Control prose instead of Core-owned tests or contracts.
The review would promote broader Core truth while Core remains unknown in Project Control.
verificationTarget: Core has a reviewed consumer export boundary or a documented no-go decision, with evidence that Editor and Backend imports stay within approved surfaces.
summary: Identify the Core package surfaces that are safe for current Editor and Backend consumers before product-wide compatibility promotion.
